package main

import (
	"context"
	"flag"
	"fmt"
	"os"

	_ "github.com/mattn/go-sqlite3"
	"golang.org/x/crypto/bcrypt"

	"example.com/fabrica/storage-annotations/internal/storage/ent"
	"example.com/fabrica/storage-annotations/internal/storage/ent/user"
)

func main() {
	if err := run(); err != nil {
		fmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, err)
		os.Exit(1)
	}
}

func run() error {
	databaseURL := flag.String("database-url", "file:./data.db?_fk=1", "SQLite connection URL")
	username := flag.String("username", "", "username to inspect")
	plaintext := flag.String("plaintext", "", "expected bcrypt plaintext")
	recoveryHint := flag.String("recovery-hint", "", "expected ordinary sensitive value")
	flag.Parse()
	if *username == "" || *plaintext == "" {
		return fmt.Errorf("username and plaintext are required")
	}

	client, err := ent.Open("sqlite3", *databaseURL)
	if err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("open SQLite: %w", err)
	}
	defer client.Close()

	entity, err := client.User.Query().Where(user.SpecUsernameEQ(*username)).Only(context.Background())
	if err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("query user: %w", err)
	}
	if entity.SpecPassword == *plaintext {
		return fmt.Errorf("password stored as plaintext")
	}
	if err := bcrypt.CompareHashAndPassword([]byte(entity.SpecPassword), []byte(*plaintext)); err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("bcrypt verification: %w", err)
	}
	if entity.SpecRecoveryHint != *recoveryHint {
		return fmt.Errorf("ordinary sensitive value was not stored")
	}

	fmt.Printf("storage receipt: user=%s bcrypt_match=true plaintext=false ordinary_sensitive_stored=true\n", *username)
	return nil
}
